title: stream.export request

cache_scope.description: Base-analysis cache scope. full (default) is reusable by query, export, and dynamic validate; use range explicitly for a one-off narrow interval. range without time_range reuses full.

channel.description: Action-specific channel input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

kind.description: Action-specific kind input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

line_limit.description: Limits returned evidence rows only, not scanning, aggregation, or the verdict; read completeness fields as well.

path.description: Action-specific path input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

verbose.description: Action-specific verbose input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

output.description: Export destination and rendering controls. path, file_format, and verbose are supported only where this action declares them.

stream.description: Action-specific stream input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

begin.description: Action-specific begin input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

end.description: Action-specific end input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

time_range.description: Closed analysis interval. begin and end may be omitted independently to use the available waveform bounds.

time_unit.description: Interprets only unitless time numbers; it never overrides a time string that already has a unit.

value_format.description: Action-specific value_format input. Its type and accepted values are defined by this schema.

description: Export stream transfers or packet data from an explicit full or range base-cache scope.
x-purpose: 导出 stream 查询结果。
x-how_it_works: 按 kind/format 从 query/dynamic validate 共用的 full/range base 写出；kind 只能是 transfer、packet、packet_beats。
x-when_to_use: 把流数据输出给外部脚本并避免重复扫描。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: stream; cache_scope: full(default) / range; kind: transfer / packet / packet_beats; format: tsv / csv / xout; when kind=packet_beats: output
x-description-zh: 从显式 full 或 range 基础分析缓存范围导出 stream 查询结果。

use_when: 从显式 full 或 range 基础分析缓存范围导出 stream 查询结果。
do_not_use_when: 不要把本 action 用于 stream.config.load、stream.config.list 的业务目标；请改用列出的同域 action。
constraints: required: stream; cache_scope: full(default) / range; kind: transfer / packet / packet_beats; format: tsv / csv / xout; when kind=packet_beats: output
